page: Vultr vbm-112c-2048gb-8-h100-gpu is a bare metal server configured for intensive computational workloads. It features dual Intel Xeon 8480+ processors with x86_64 architecture, delivering 112 physical cores and 224 vCPUs at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The system is equipped with 2015.0 GB of system memory, providing approximately 9.0 GB of RAM per physical core to support large-scale data processing.

The primary feature of this server is its integrated graphics processing array, which consists of eight NVIDIA H100 Hopper GPUs. These accelerators provide a combined total of 640 GB of high-bandwidth VRAM, with each GPU utilizing 80 GiB. Local storage is provided by a 1920 GB NVMe SSD, offering high-speed local read and write capabilities for operating systems and active datasets. The server also includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Given the high-density hardware profile, this bare metal server represents a significant resource commitment designed for specialized workloads. The inclusion of eight enterprise-grade GPUs and over two terabytes of system memory makes it highly efficient for tasks requiring massive parallel processing capabilities. It is structurally optimized for large language model training, deep learning, complex data science jobs, and high-performance computing simulations where virtualized overhead must be avoided.
